en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestoned square bordered by 2–3‑storey houses with shutters and shopfronts, large chestnut trees in bloom, and townspeople in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century dress. A horse‑drawn cart stands in the foreground. The caption at the top reads "Hermannstadt. Dragonerwache." The reverse side is printed with "LEVELEZŐ-LAP." and address lines, plus a small publisher line at the bottom and a purple ownership stamp.
